newsitem.title: HONG KONG: SmarTone Hong Kong flotation 2.95 times subscribed.
newsitem.headline: SmarTone Hong Kong flotation 2.95 times subscribed.

text.p: The Hong Kong flotation of shares of mobile telephone operator SmarTone Telecommunications Holdings Ltd is 2.95 times subscribed, the company said in a statement on Tuesday.

SmarTone said it received applications for a total 33.40 million shares compared with 11.34 million shares available for public subscription in Hong Kong. Another 1.26 million shares for the company's employees were fully allotted, it said.
The Hong Kong public offer issue price has been set at HK$17.25 per share and dealing in the shares is expected to begin on October 31, 1996, it said.
SmarTone offered 84 million shares globally of which 15 percent was offered in Hong Kong and 85 percent in an international placement.

SmarTone is 40 percent owned by Sun Hung Kai Properties Ltd, 30 percent by AT&T Wireless Communications, 15 percent by ABC Communications (Holdings) Ltd and 15 percent by Town Khan Ltd, a unit of China's Ministry of Post and Telecommunications. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6370
